input_delta_from_attempt3: EXACTLY two value substitutions: starttime 2025-11-15 -> 2025-11-15T00:00:00.000000 and endtime 2025-11-16 -> 2025-11-16T00:00:00.000000; endpoint, abbreviated parameter names, bbox, net, cha, level, format, nodata, method, host, registered 12-station filter, and epoch rule byte-identical to attempt 3
presence_rule: presence computed ONLY for the registered CI stations with an HHZ channel epoch active in [2025-11-15, 2025-11-16); outside-station rows retained in raw evidence, excluded by the filter; a proper subset of the 12 is an honest per-day presence result
